decision_rule: Posting age (coordinator ruling 2026-11-17, Mellott): a board date counts as a first-posted date unless the board shows a re-list or re-stamp (several requisitions stamped within minutes as old requisitions, 'Updated <older date>' text, a JSON date that differs from the list date, a requisition number older than siblings that were first posted earlier); a posting whose own requisition is older than 12 months is a standing ad (labor 12 unless several counted postings or a bonus). Apply flow (ruling 2026-11-17, Kafka): an own-page ad counts only with an ATS, an application form or an email/apply instruction for that job; a generic Indeed/LinkedIn company link does not. Lines: battery R5 rules (every fact and question premise on a stated row of the plant with its date; no live counts; 'listed' for board dates; plans not written as progress; opening lines end with a 'you' question; bottleneck guesses hedged). Corrected otherwise confirmed; unreachable only if a source cannot be reached at all.
